exposure: CSP patients with good postoperative outcomes
blood flow around the GS at the site of the previous caesarean incision
blood flow around the gestational sac (GS)
cohort: 98 caesarean scar pregnancy (CSP) patients who underwent transabdominal ultrasound-guided hysteroscopic curettage during early pregnancy
finding: The residual myometrium thickness (RMT), blood flow around the GS at the site of the previous caesarean incision, and types of CSP had a low correlation with postoperative complications, such as intraoperative blood loss ≥ 200 ml or RPOC, of early pregnancy termination in patients with CSP.
